name: Nexus LLM policy panel failure-path scenarios
trigger: Call the real handleLlmPolicyGet/handleLlmPolicyPut over a temporary config dir: owner write, stranger write, invalid schema, two concurrent writes, and a missing-file read.
observe: each case records ux.sim.llm-policy-panel/case with caseId, pass, and HTTP status in the isolated test logs
rejection reasons are non-empty and the previous policy file stays byte-for-byte
the concurrent race settles on exactly one of the two valid documents
expected: All five cases pass with statuses 200/401/400 and the previous policy is never overwritten by a rejected or unauthorized write (OP #125562 failure-path contract).
